service.name: Yacht rock band
service.serviceType: Yacht rock cover band for company parties, patios and private events
service.description: A yacht rock cover band playing Doobie Brothers, Steely Dan, Hall and Oates, Toto, Christopher Cross and Michael McDonald in three-part harmony with saxophone, for summer company parties, client appreciation evenings, after-parties and milestone birthdays across Denver and Colorado.

faqs.q: What is a yacht rock band?
faqs.a: A band that plays the smooth end of late-70s and early-80s pop and soft rock: the Doobie Brothers with Michael McDonald, Steely Dan, Hall and Oates, Toto, Christopher Cross, Boz Scaggs, Kenny Loggins, Ambrosia, Player, the Fleetwood Mac ballads. The songs live or die on the harmony vocals and the saxophone, which is why the build carries three voices and a horn.

faqs.q: Which events book a yacht rock band?
faqs.a: Summer company parties and picnics, client appreciation evenings on a patio, the late set at a gala or a holiday party once the program is over, and milestone birthdays for a crowd that grew up on the songs. It reads as a party band, not a tribute act, so it works for a mixed-age crowd and a room that wants to sing along without a theme.

It is a dance floor act, and on a patio it runs at a level the venue's cap allows. Before the night turns, the same band plays a dinner set at conversation volume, 65 to 72 dBA at the nearest table. If your venue enforces a decibel limit, give us the number at contract and the set is built under it.

Yes, and patios and lawns are its natural work. The requirements are a covered, level and dry performance area with power run to it, and a move-indoors call written before the day. Colorado afternoons turn fast, and the electronics stop behaving in the wet.

faqs.q: How much space does the band need?
faqs.a: The four-piece plays in 14 by 10 feet on two dedicated 20-amp circuits with a 90-minute load-in. The five to six piece with saxophone needs a little more width. Sound sized to the venue is included at every size, and the footprints are published on the technical page.

faqs.q: Can the yacht rock band follow another act?
faqs.a: Yes. It is often the second half of a night that opened with a duo or a solo pianist through drinks and dinner, on the same contract and the same sound system, and it hands off to the DJ the same way when the night runs past the band.
